thesis: The founders of Kong describe their early struggle to raise funding in San Francisco while living on a $1,000 monthly budget as three people sharing an Airbnb mattress and eating rice, beans, tuna, and pasta. They secured their initial capital through a difficult negotiation with investor Kevin Donahue, which involved a counter-offer facilitated by the investor locking the founders in a bathroom to prevent them from leaving before finalizing the deal.
